title: Natha Khehra Refuses to Surrender Mehtab Singh’s Son

blocks.text: When the Mughal commander closes in, he tries to force compliance through cruelty rather than negotiation. Noordin addressed Natha Khehra and demanded either the hidden Mehtab Singh or the child who represented his line, refusing any plea for mercy.

Natha Khehra understands that surrender would only invite more humiliation and death. He resolves instead to protect Mehtab Singh’s son even if the choice means abandoning safety and accepting battle on unequal terms.
The page therefore turns from siege to rescue. Trust, kinship, and duty become stronger than fear, and escape begins under the shadow of almost certain pursuit.
